patch: Liraasa 3.5 — Essentials, archetypes and modular packs
status: PROPOSED: ratify tier 1 first; tier 2 may be ratified, deferred or dropped item by item
principles: No new roots: every entry is built from existing headwords.
Alias before coining: an existing word gets an English name rather than a new synonym.
Recipe before word: grammar that already says it is documented, not lexicalised.

Modular: every entry carries a module; apply_patch.py --modules selects which to merge. core is the essentials; archetypes, qualities and casual extend the general lexicon; pack.* are optional domain packs.

modules.core: The 75 everyday essentials, get-recipes, shapes (G150) and copied names (G151)
modules.archetypes: Compounds on existing heads: people, events, measures, tools, media, places, materials, animals, clothing, land, groups, ideas, body, food, verbs, ways, vehicles, plants
modules.qualities: Quality adjectives and adverbs: worthy-of and heart compounds, aliases, recipes
modules.derived-aliases: English names for relational adjectives already formed by 3.3:G148 and for existing near-synonyms

rulings_add.rule: A numeral joined by a hyphen to gaki (angle) names a polygon: tressa-gaki triangle, cuara-gaki square or quadrilateral, penta-gaki pentagon. rinba (ring) is the circle and vemisovla (sphere) the ball shape. The -san adjective follows: cuara-gakisan, square-shaped.

Foreign dishes, products and fixed proper concepts with no Liraasa equivalent are copied like names (2.0:G45), respelled in Liraasa letters, lower-case as common nouns, and given -san for adjectives: pitsa (pizza), hamburga (hamburger). Prefer a native compound whenever one is transparent.
